**Resubmitted — deterministic failure repaired.**

- **Repair:** the split construction is gone. The Company's period now reads contiguously as "upon sixty (60) days, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days, written notice to the other", so the 60-day non-renewal window is unambiguous on its face.
- **Why not the verifier's exact suggested phrasing:** "...sixty (60) days written notice, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice, to the other" expands 15 words to 23 (ratio 1.53) and failed the minimality gate. The validated variant carries the same operative meaning within the ceiling by moving the shared "written notice to the other" tail after both periods.
- **Unchanged and confirmed:** HDI's ninety-day window retained (no weakening of Customer), one-year initial term, automatic one-year renewal, notice direction and the "Termination Date" definition all intact; no reminder mechanic, uplift cap or other non-element language added.
- **Element coverage:** notice window addressed by operation 1; price-increase cap already met (fixed 30% revenue share, no renewal uplift). Preferred gaps noted in the rationale only.
